description: This file contains a unit test for the Core::ProcessInfo class, which retrieves and displays various process-related information, including process name, ID, priority, activity status, executable path, and child process details.

classes.name: Core::ProcessInfo
classes.description: A class providing information about a process, such as name, ID, priority, activity status, executable path, memory usage, and child processes.

classes.name: Core::ProcessInfo::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the list of child processes.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the process.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the process.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Returns whether the process is active.

methods.name: Executable
methods.description: Returns the executable path/name of the process.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Returns the amount of allocated memory for the process.

methods.name: Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident set size (memory in use) of the process.

methods.name: Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size of the process.

methods.name: Children
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing child processes.
